source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Press "F4" to save the change and exit

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify that the board-defined F4 Save & Exit function commits one explicitly approved BIOS change, exits setup and reaches the expected boot path with the value persisted.
original_method: Back up the BIOS state, make a reversible non-critical change, press F4, visually confirm the save/exit prompt, allow the approved reset or boot, and compare the persisted value and platform health to the plan.
manual_activity: A qualified human must create the approved pending change, press F4, evaluate/confirm the save prompt and observe the exit/boot transition.
required_inputs: Exact reversible change and expected value
Stable power, console/operator and recovery method
safety_requirements: One authorized approval must name the change and planned reboot/boot path.
Do not press F4 with unknown or additional pending changes.
Protect boot, storage, security, thermal and power settings.
Keep power stable during commit and stop on prompt ambiguity.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare configuration diff, approval and evidence plan.
Collect supplied pre/post inventory and logs.
Compare expected/actual without operating the BIOS UI or assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact change and recovery plan.
Perform/confirm F4 Save & Exit and observe boot.
Validate persistence/health, restore if required and issue verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct that SSH cannot prove F4 UI behavior, but persistence and recovery evidence are also required.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the F4 interaction; use read-only inventory only as supporting pre/post evidence, never as a key-action substitute.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F4 Save & Exit and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the sole pending change, F4, confirmation, reset/exit, persisted value, expected boot and recovery in one auditable chain.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board/BIOS after F4 mapping confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an exact reversible payload and proves persistence plus platform recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Saving an unspecified change can make the host unbootable or unreachable.

project_override_considerations: The project may select the reversible field and whether to restore it after proof; execution evidence must identify the saved value and cannot claim other settings were exercised.
expected_evidence: Persisted value plus BMC/OS health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently defines F4 Save & Exit. The missing change and expected boot path are necessary project inputs, not contradictory source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The save/exit intent is clear; absent configuration, console or recovery inputs defer execution.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual UI dependency but lacks persistence scope.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates manual action, supporting tool evidence, execution status and engineer-owned verdict and locks variant identity.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic F4 response from passing without proving the intended value was the only committed change and the planned boot path recovered.
independent_technical_reasoning: F4 combines a human UI action with a state commit and boot transition. Automated post-checks can support evidence, but the approval-sensitive commit and visual prompt remain the core, so MANUAL ONLY applies.

source_provenance.history: Repository exact-code search and distinct row 1459 downgrade variant

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat F4, reconfirm the save, reboot or restore automatically after an unexpected prompt or boot result.
